title: Blood of My Blood
subtitle: Light may fade at dusk, but promises never will.

items.text: Against the rattle of gunfire outside, the warehouse seems unnervingly quiet.
Warehouse, Nika Checkpoint
The vampire's invitation still awaits a response. The girl bows her head, staring at her shadow.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Let me remind you that, although my life may be everlasting, my patience is not.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: I have to say, your hesitation is disappointing.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: What's this going to cost me?
She looks into his crimson eyes.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Every time I've been offered any kind of gift in my life, every time I've even come close to something ...

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: It's either been taken away from me or turned out to be a complete fraud.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: So, sir, which one is it?

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Neither. Because I'm not offering you any "gifts," only an alternative reality.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: All it takes is a drop of blood and a little bravery, because there's a good chance you'll end up just like them.
He lifts a limp arm, waving it at her mockingly.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: A small ask, I'm sure, for someone such as yourself.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: What's a little risk when your dreams are so very close? This is what you want, isn't it?
He stands by the window, hand reaching for her.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Yes, I crave it.
Dizziness grips her. A sudden, crushing tide of "fortune" crashes over Rubuska.
Stone, walls, cargo ... everything melts away.
She stands in the middle of the cemetery under a blood moon.
Yes, the same damp cemetery her mother described a thousand times.
Before her looms the vampire, Pyrrhos, cloaked in black like an ageless shadow.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: I can read it in your eyes.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: The urge, the desire—an eagerness to embrace the stillness of the dark and be rid of all your mortal troubles.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: And here I am, your wish-maker. Come to send you to the sweet cradle of night or of death.
Moonlight spills over his face. His red eyes overflowing. Blood, corpses, and the reek of death reflecting in them.
She sees more than that; their dead eyes meet hers in the reflection.
"Choose!" They whisper.
You cannot refuse us, just as you cannot refuse your past.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Well? What do you say?
Faces flicker before her—mother, father, brother, and comrades.
It is a chance to see them again. How could she refuse?

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Yes.
Detention Room

items.speaker: Children
items.text: Rubuska!

items.speaker: Annabelle
items.text: She's not here.
Armed men storm in, but the familiar figure is gone.
Blood stains the floor, still warm, trailing like a serpent.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: There are drag marks. Seems they've transferred some of the captives.
Yellow light cuts across the room. Shadows twitch in the corners. A familiar voice whimpers faintly.

items.speaker: Little William
items.text: *whimper* Home. I just want to go home.

items.speaker: Dorothy
items.text: It's alright, child. I'm here with you. We'll be fine.

items.speaker: Annabelle
items.text: William! Ms. Dorothy!
Annabelle rushes forward, clutching her long-lost kin.

items.speaker: Dorothy
items.text: Don't! There's—
Shadows lunge from the opposite corner.
Arrrrgh!

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Prepare for battle!
Detention Room

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: *coughing*
The soldier crumples, eyes bloodshot, veins crawling like creeping vines across his temple.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Where's Pyrrhos? Where did he take the girl?
She seizes him by his bloody collar.

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: W-Warehouse. At the station. Lots of ... Lots of them there ...
He coughs, words slurred, gurgling.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Did he do this to you?

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: Yes ...
He gasps, then smiles strangely.

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: It's too late.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: What? Speak up.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Ah ...
A cry rises in the distance.
It is long, ecstatic, weary, like a bird to its nest, a ship finding shore.

items.speaker: Aima
items.text: It's Rubuska! That sound—Is she ...

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: Argh. It's too late. Soon ...

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: Your friend will be a vampire! Hahahahaha ...
He laughs until bloody tears streak his face. In his throat, he releases a stream of broken whispers, another voice takes over.

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: Gushing, seething, a torrent red. We, the cattle, a plague we spread.

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: We are the spawn, the vampire's aide, to turn this earth a crimson shade.

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: The "Storm" forms as it did before.

items.speaker: Infected Soldier
items.text: No wars, no conflict—nevermore!
A gunshot. Blood sprays.
Corvus lowers her weapon, her stitched face grave.

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: Ah. He's even turned his own army. It's no wonder these Infected are crawlin' all over the place.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: "The 'Storm' forms ..."
She crouches, inspecting the corpse with an investigator's eye.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: Something's been off since the beginning. The symptoms have taken hold too rapidly. There has never been a recorded instance of the infection spreading so fast.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: Look here. Burst veins, pupils so dilated they almost cover the entire iris. The infection's been accelerated.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: In other words, these are no regular Infected. They're the failed product of a different kind of transformation.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: One task at a time.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Come. We need to find Rubuska.
Moments earlier ...

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Well? What do you say?

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Very good. I knew you'd come to your senses.
Satisfied with the answer, he offers a sharp, beastly smile.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Come child. It's time to leave the ugly trappings of mortality behind you.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Once we have the same blood pulsing through our veins ...

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: We will build a new world, united in death.
This is the "bloodline" she has longed for.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Мама, Dad, Kolyo.
An echo of her childhood.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: I'll protect you.
Tugging at the shreds of her surviving faith.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Till the end of time.
The next second, shadows surge like a black tide.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Hm? A shadow?

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Uggh!

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: You ... Why?

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: I want to be a vampire more than anything I've ever wanted.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: To have the power to save the people I love from death.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: To be the one to protect and provide.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: But I never want to be like you! I may have red eyes and fangs, but I don't want to lie and manipulate to get what I want!

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Heh. Did you really think I'd just surrender? That I'd take the easy way out? My family wants me to live.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: So, I'll live, damn it! Live until the smoke clears and the sky turns blue again, till the rain puts out the fires and the primroses bloom in the forests of Strandzha!

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: I'll live till my friends grow old and gray and wrinkly, till my family comes back!

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: I'll live! We'll all live!

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: And you—you will rot in your grave!

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: You wretched bastard!
The true vampire convulses on the floor, his chest heaving like an old bellows.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: I did it. I killed him.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: It's over.
Rubuska settles on the floor, feeling her heart pounding louder and louder.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: Have to get back to the train. Have to tell them.
She scrambles back up and staggers toward the door. She knows her friends are still waiting.
*sound of attacking*
Before she can cry out, her body is flung through the air and slams to the ground.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Heh. Don't tell me you believe those bedtime stories?
Pyrrhos stands, his face twisted into a grotesque look of sinister joy.

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: How? You-You should've ...

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Died? *tut* Don't be absurd. Listening to that silly little speech was more painful than any stake to the chest.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Let me guess, you brought holy water and garlic, too?

He looms over the girl, dismissing her attempt with a wave of his hand.
An unseen shadow coils around her throat, tightening, then tightening again.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Those legends were merely that—naught but childish forgeries, just like you, little "vampire."

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: No ...

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Oh, what a waste of time you turned out to be. I truly believed you might share my vision.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: But, alas, you're just as narrow-minded as the rest of them.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: I suppose it's time you found your place in the dirt. If you're lucky, someone might bring you back someday, then you can act out your little "noble-hearted vampire" charade once more.
Her vision blurs.
The moon, streaks of blood, the cemetery ... everything that once made up her childhood crumbles to ruin.
And with it, her dreams of becoming a vampire.
Look! Her shadow—it's moving!
You're a real vampire, right, Rubuska?

items.speaker: Rubuska
items.text: It's not a lie.
She closes her eyes, arms slack at her sides, bloodlike tears trailing down her face.
The door bursts open from a weighty kick.
Footsteps ring out, steady, strong, then faster, faster.
A hail of bullets tears through the vampire's shoulder.

items.speaker: Pyrrhos
items.text: Ugh!
Pyrrhos releases her before melting into shadow.
Air floods back into her lungs. A familiar tall figure comes into focus.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Rubuska.
She crouches to reach the girl; glimpses of relief and concern pass over her patchwork face.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Finally. We've found you.
